question: Do sign-gauge-invariant quadratic response signatures identify A1, A2, and off across reversed tense directions?

prior_art.known_lessons: Raw source centroids collapse to off; nested ridge is perfect within parity but collapses on opposite tense direction; even/odd parity exactly reverses present_to_past versus past_to_present; the gold union composes.
prior_art.novelty: Replace signed 2304-dimensional deltas with six fixed Gram invariants of the two proposed expert writes, testing a low-complexity quadratic interaction router rather than another linear fit.

frozen_design.features: For A1/A2 proposed entry12 deltas, compute [mean squared norm A1, mean squared norm A2, mean inner product] at the semantic token and averaged over the semantic prefix; apply log1p to nonnegative norm entries. Six scalars total, invariant to simultaneous sign reversal.
frozen_design.router: Training-feature z-score with floor 1e-8 followed by deterministic cosine nearest centroids for A1, A2, and off=(P union C), fit on opposite parity only. No hyperparameters or outcome selection.
frozen_design.causal_program: Select A1 delta, A2 delta, or zero, project through the fixed construction union, and install at entry12. No held labels, logits, answer IDs, or downstream outcomes enter routing.
frozen_design.controls: Report feature distributions, reversal-invariance unit tests, held confusion, learned/gold/ungated programs, full/zero replays, and P/C KL/flips.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_scope_geometry_f: Hashes, direction-parity audit, sign-invariance tests, replays, crossfit, finite features, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_gram_router_identifies_held_branc: Held macro accuracy is >=.875 in both parities and no P/C row is predicted A1/A2.
predictions.pred_c_routed_union_preserves_both_targe: The routed program projects >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875 on both targets in both parities.
predictions.pred_d_routed_union_is_control_selective: The program has zero P/C flips and mean KL <=.02 in both parities.
predictions.pred_e_router_retains_ungated_union_effe: Every routed target projection is at least 90% of its corresponding ungated union projection.

decision: A failure invalidates. B/C/D/E licenses OOD testing and weight translation. Gold pass with B failure closes the six-scalar sign-invariant response router and sends branch identification to an explicit token-level or richer nonlinear circuit, not more linear regularization.
